tools.name: latest_changes
tools.description: The newest published changes, newest first, 20 per page, each with its AiSeek page.

tools.name: search_changes
tools.description: Published changes matching words (a company, a country, a subject), most relevant first.

tools.name: get_change
tools.description: A published change with its summary, scores, main subject and the sources that reported it (outlet, link, date, kind).

tools.name: country_heat
tools.description: SeekMap's Change Heat per country: how much verified change happened there, against the day before, with its domains and last seven days. The window is capped by the key's plan (Free 7 days, Pro 30, Intelligence 90).

tools.name: release_calendar
tools.description: Scheduled releases and decisions (central banks, statistics offices, earnings) between two times; Free keys see yesterday, today and tomorrow (UTC).

tools.name: company
tools.description: A company's profile, listings and recent changes by its AiSeek slug, or a list of matching companies by name.

tools.name: latest_brief
tools.description: The latest daily or weekly brief: the period's changes by section. On a Free key a brief opens one day after publication.
